history.dynasty: Rewa/Devarajnagar princely era (CONFLICT between sources on founder)
history.summary: Venkatesh Temple at Mukhtiyarganj, Satna, is dedicated to Lord Vishnu as Venkateshwar and is the only temple in the Vindhya region built in the South Indian architectural style, with a tall gopuram, intricate carvings and red stonework. One account (newandolder.com) says Maharaja Randaman Singh of the Devarajnagar royal family commissioned it, built over 49 years (1876-1925) with artisans brought from South India; the ashtadhatu main idol was crafted by Jaipur artisans, with shrines of Ranganath Bhagwan and Swami Narayan flanking the sanctum. CONFLICT (verify): another account (indialite.blogspot.com) says Maharaja Raghuraj Singh of Rewa laid the foundation stone in 1925. The complex includes a 10-acre garden, part of the Smart City Mission beautification.

name: Venkatesh Temple
town_description: Satna is the headquarters of Satna district in the Baghelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh, on the NH-30 corridor. Founded in 1865 by Maharaja Raghuraj Singh of Rewa, it is a commercial and educational hub of the Vindhya region. It is the gateway to the Maihar Sharda temple, Chitrakoot and Ramvan, and takes its name from the Satna river, a tributary of the Tons.

travel.airport: No airport in Satna; nearest is Khajuraho (~120 km, 3 hrs by road) or Jabalpur (~200 km) (per newandolder.com).
travel.railway: Satna Junction is a major rail junction; temple is ~5-6 km from the station (auto-rickshaw/cab, 10-15 min).
travel.road: Satna is on NH-30; temple is at Mukhtiyarganj (HRHH+3MH) in the heart of the city. Satna-Rewa ~50 km, Maihar ~40 km.

visitor_information.opening_hours: 9:00 am - 8:30 pm all day, per newandolder.com (verify).
